subject: Welcome to Elythia
body:
You're here! Isn't it just beautiful? From my window, anyway. Mostly.

Look for the little floating lights near the Glimmering Pools. Those are Glimmers, and a Spirit Apple will make one your friend. Stay away from the big cocoons under the trees... Grim's been spit at too many times.

The lab is out in the rolling fields.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
